item.title: Autobahn Therapeutics Bipolar Depression
item.description:
• Summary: Autobahn Therapeutics is advancing toward a pivotal trial after its thyroid hormone receptor agonist showed promise in easing symptoms of bipolar depression. The mid-stage study met its primary endpoint, providing a potential new treatment option for patients with bipolar disorder. The drug mimics thyroid hormone signaling in the brain, which is thought to modulate mood and cognition.
  • MoAs: Thyroid hormone receptor agonist (specifically targeting thyroid hormone signaling in the central nervous system).
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech
